What we restore

Pick the situation that matches yours. Each page explains what we can do, what we can’t, and how insurance usually treats it.

  • Vandalism and break-in restoration: keyed paint, spray paint, broken-glass cleanup, damaged or soiled interiors.
  • Paint overspray removal: construction, roofing and industrial overspray lifted off paint, glass and trim without repainting.
  • Water damage restoration: rain and leak intrusion, wet carpet and padding, odor and mildew prevention.
  • Broken glass and interior cleanup: the glass is replaced by a glass shop; we handle everything the break left behind.

How it works

  1. Send photos and a short description through our estimate form, or call the shop.
  2. We review the damage and reply with next steps during business hours. Some jobs we can estimate from photos; others need a look in person.
  3. You receive a written, itemized estimate with photos. If you are filing a claim, that is what you send your insurer or show the adjuster.
  4. Once you (and your insurer, if you are claiming) decide to proceed, we schedule the work and keep you posted until pickup.

What we are honest about

  • Deep scratches that are through the clear coat and paint need a body shop. We will tell you that instead of polishing something that cannot be polished.
  • We are not a glass shop. We coordinate the cleanup and interior side and can work alongside whichever glass shop you or your insurer choose.
  • Severe flooding (water above the seat bottoms, submerged electronics, standing water for days) is often a total-loss conversation with your insurer, not a restoration job. We will say so.
  • Hail and dent repair: ask us. We will point you to the right option for the damage rather than promise a result.

Working with your insurance

Vandalism, falling objects, water and glass damage are typically handled under the comprehensive portion of an auto policy, but every policy is different, and some people choose to pay out of pocket to protect their rates. Coverage, and what your deductible is, are always your insurance company’s decision, never ours.

We don’t bill your insurance company for you: you receive a written, itemized estimate and photos you can submit with your claim, and we work from the estimate once you decide to proceed. If an adjuster wants to see the vehicle or talk through the estimate, we are glad to walk them through it.

Questions people ask

Do I have to file an insurance claim to use you?

No. Many customers pay out of pocket, especially when the repair is close to their deductible. You get the same written estimate either way, so you can decide after you see the number.

Will you talk to my adjuster?

Yes. We will explain the estimate line by line and show the adjuster the damage in person or by photo. The coverage decision stays with your insurer.

How fast can you look at my vehicle?

Send photos through the estimate form and we will reply with next steps during business hours. If the damage needs an in-person look, we will tell you when to bring it by.

Do you repair body damage or replace glass?

We are a detail and restoration shop. We handle paint correction, interior restoration, odor and cleanup. Dents, panel repair and glass replacement go to a body or glass shop, and we are happy to work alongside them.
